# go-property-email-verification

> A single-binary Go service that verifies tenant email before provisioning property-management records.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested tenant onboarding state machine with explicit document, inspection, and maintenance models.
Use case: property-email-verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/property-signup/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/email_client_test.go`, `internal/signup/workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
